title: Towards Self-Improving Error Diagnosis in Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Long multi-agent traces obscure the agent and earliest step responsible for a failure.
assumption_broken: Failure diagnosis need not remain a static judge or depend on annotated retraining.
operational_signature: Decompose → trace backward → verify hypotheses → retain reusable patterns
load_bearing_mechanism: Executable verification gates writes to episodic memory so reusable diagnoses accumulate without unsupported patterns.
limitations_evident: Silent failures lack explicit diagnostic signals
Multi-agent verification increases inference latency
Only three backbone families evaluated

title: Co-evolving Agent Architectures and Interpretable Reasoning for Automated Optimization
problem: Handcrafted reasoning-execution pipelines cannot adapt their structure to heterogeneous optimization tasks.
assumption_broken: Agent workflow topology and reasoning trajectories can be optimized rather than fixed in advance.
operational_signature: Initialize → merge trajectories → recombine and mutate → evaluate and prune
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared architecture graph recombines successful reasoning fragments while fitness-weighted updates evolve the search space.

improver_modified.how: The architecture graph guiding subsequent path-conditioned recombination is expanded, reweighted, and pruned using evaluated trajectories.

limitations_evident: Mandatory phase order constrains architecture search
Fitness uses a small fixed training subset
Knowledge-base construction requires leakage controls

title: Training LLM Agents for Spontaneous, Reward-Free Self-Evolution via World Knowledge Exploration
problem: Reactive web agents cannot reliably explore and summarize unfamiliar environments before receiving tasks.
assumption_broken: Environment adaptation need not require inference-time task rewards if useful exploration is learned during training.
operational_signature: Explore → summarize → measure downstream utility → select trajectories and fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: Outcome-based rejection sampling trains exploration policies to generate knowledge that improves downstream task success.

improver_modified.how: SFT followed by two rejection-sampling fine-tuning iterations updates the policy that generates world knowledge.

limitations_evident: Exploration uses hundreds of steps
Reward evaluation requires many downstream executions
Websites need graph-based preprocessing

title: Agent-World: Scaling Real-World Environment Synthesis for Evolving General Agent Intelligence
problem: General agent training lacks diverse realistic stateful environments and targeted lifelong learning signals.
assumption_broken: Training environments and tasks can evolve with diagnosed policy weaknesses rather than remain static.
operational_signature: Mine environments → synthesize verifiable tasks → train policies → diagnose gaps and expand
load_bearing_mechanism: An executable diagnostic arena targets new environment-task synthesis at capability gaps during reinforcement learning.
limitations_evident: Environment and task synthesis depend on strong teacher models
Some evaluations use sampled benchmark subsets
Repeated evaluations report means without variance in supplied text

title: A Self-Evolving Framework for Efficient Terminal Agents via Observational Context Compression
problem: Noisy terminal observations saturate context while naive compression removes action-critical evidence.
assumption_broken: Observation compression rules can be learned and reused online without task-success rewards or compressor training.
operational_signature: Match rules → preserve critical output → detect complaints → revise and retain rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Conservative structured filters evolve from agent over-compression complaints and accumulate in a ranked global rule pool.
limitations_evident: Evolution revisits the same dataset across rounds
Implicit complaints can miss information loss
Smaller models may consume more total tokens

title: Prism: An Evolutionary Memory Substrate for Multi-Agent Open-Ended Discovery
problem: Open-ended multi-agent discovery needs persistent shared knowledge and adaptive retrieval without context saturation.
assumption_broken: Memory organization and retrieval strategies can evolve with downstream utility rather than remain fixed.
operational_signature: Extract → stratify and connect → retrieve adaptively → consolidate and decay
load_bearing_mechanism: Outcome-weighted retrieval strategy selection and memory confidence dynamics concentrate shared knowledge on useful reusable information.

improver_modified.how: The retrieval strategy selector updates its strategy probabilities from downstream outcome quality.

limitations_evident: Extraction and consolidation require LLM calls
Automatically inferred causal edges are imperfect
Evolutionary benchmarks are small-scale

title: Forage V2: Knowledge Evolution and Transfer in Autonomous Agent Organizations
problem: Open-world agents underestimate task scope and lose hard-won knowledge between runs.
assumption_broken: Completion criteria can co-evolve independently of execution while organizational experience transfers across models.
operational_signature: Explore independently → evaluate scope → extract lessons → seed subsequent runs
load_bearing_mechanism: Append-only advisory lessons transfer domain and evaluation knowledge while physically separated agent workspaces preserve audit independence.

improver_modified.how: The evaluator rewrites completeness criteria and evaluation code as exploration reveals scope, and inherits evaluation lessons across runs.

limitations_evident: Only static information spaces evaluated
Self-discovered coverage is not external correctness
Context exhaustion causes complete run failures

title: EvoAgent: An Evolvable Agent Framework with Skill Learning and Multi-Agent Delegation
problem: Manually authored static skills fail to accumulate user-specific capability across complex professional sessions.
assumption_broken: Multi-file skills can be generated and structurally refined asynchronously from ordinary user interactions.
operational_signature: Match skills → execute and collect feedback → analyze sessions → update reusable skills
load_bearing_mechanism: An offline user-feedback loop converts interaction histories and usage statistics into new or refined structured skill packages.
limitations_evident: Evaluation distribution comes from the deployed system
Architecture harms some substituted backbone models
No component ablations isolate improvement sources

title: Learning to Evolve: A Self-Improving Framework for Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Parameter Graph Optimization
problem: Flat static prompt optimizers cannot diagnose interacting multi-agent components or learn from prior optimization attempts.
assumption_broken: The optimizer can reuse its own validated optimization history while modifying both textual content and graph structure.
operational_signature: Decompose configuration → diagnose and cluster failures → retrieve past edits → validate graph proposals
load_bearing_mechanism: GRAO retrieves historical optimization experience to stabilize graph edits generated from clustered textual gradients.

improver_modified.how: Validated proposals accumulate in optimization memory and condition the optimizer's subsequent proposals through GRAO.

limitations_evident: Textual gradients have no formal optimization guarantees
Proposal validation is expensive
Graph edit operations are predefined and restricted

title: Co-Evolving LLM Decision and Skill Bank Agents for Long-Horizon Tasks
problem: Long-horizon game agents lack reusable skills aligned with their evolving decision policies.
assumption_broken: Skill discovery and skill-conditioned decision making should be trained jointly rather than separately.
operational_signature: Collect rollouts → segment behaviors → verify skill contracts → update bank and policies
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint GRPO training of decision and skill-bank agents keeps reusable skill protocols aligned with changing rollout distributions.

improver_modified.how: GRPO updates separate adapters for segmentation, contract learning, and skill-bank maintenance alongside the decision agent.

limitations_evident: Text state summaries omit visual evidence
Summarization errors accumulate over long trajectories
Cross-domain skill transfer remains future work

title: The Last Harness You'll Ever Build
problem: Every new agent domain requires manual engineering of prompts, tools, orchestration, and evaluation.
assumption_broken: The harness optimization blueprint itself can be optimized across tasks instead of remaining human-designed.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose → edit and retain → meta-optimize the adaptation blueprint
load_bearing_mechanism: An outer loop edits the evaluator, evolution agent, and loop configuration using inner-loop task performance.

improver_modified.how: The proposed meta-evolution agent modifies the evolution agent, evaluator, scoring function, and optimization-loop hyperparameters.

limitations_evident: Empirical results deferred to future work
Held-out generalization is a proposed protocol
Evaluator and scoring changes require trustworthy assessment

title: AEL: Evolving Agent Harness in Open-Ended Environments
problem: Fixed memory retrieval policies become misleading as sequential task regimes change.
assumption_broken: An agent should learn how to retrieve experience and expand its retrieval policy pool rather than merely store more memory.
operational_signature: Select policy → observe reward → diagnose degradation → inject a new policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Fast Thompson Sampling combines with slow failure-diagnosing reflection to introduce retrieval behaviors missing from the current pool.

improver_modified.how: Reflection adds new retrieval policy arms and outcome feedback updates the policy selector's posteriors.

limitations_evident: Moderate-length streams in two task families
Evolution depends on diagnostic LLM capability
Extra adaptive modules suffer data starvation

title: Frontier Coding Agents Can Now Implement an AlphaZero Self-Play Machine Learning Pipeline For Connect Four That Performs Comparably to an External Solver
problem: Broad capability benchmarks may not reveal whether coding agents can autonomously implement end-to-end AI research pipelines.
assumption_broken: Non-expert humans may elicit competitive self-play learning systems from minimal instructions rather than providing a complete research implementation.
operational_signature: Specify a budgeted task → implement and train → run tournaments → compare reliability
load_bearing_mechanism: Autonomous coding agents build self-play, neural training, and search pipelines whose resulting players are evaluated against an external solver.
limitations_evident: Single game benchmark is near saturation
Small trial groups limit statistical power
Reproducing prior breakthroughs does not demonstrate novel research

title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
problem: Heterogeneous harness edits are hard to propose and attribute from voluminous coding-agent trajectories.
assumption_broken: Tools, middleware, and memory can be automatically evolved as explicit files rather than limiting optimization to prompts.
operational_signature: Roll out → distill evidence → predict and edit → verify impacts and revert
load_bearing_mechanism: Layered trajectory evidence and per-edit falsifiable manifests connect file-level modifications to next-round task outcomes.
limitations_evident: Single ten-iteration evolution campaign
Timeout settings couple transfer to the source model
Self-attribution misses regressions and components interfere

title: Bian Que: An Agentic Framework with Flexible Skill Arrangement for Online System Operations
problem: Operational agents must select event-specific data and knowledge without drowning in irrelevant monitoring signals.
assumption_broken: Event-to-data-and-knowledge mappings can be generated and corrected as skills instead of manually maintained static configurations.
operational_signature: Match context → retrieve and diagnose → receive correction → refine skills and distill knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: A single practitioner correction updates both operational knowledge and skill-specific retrieval or reasoning specifications.
limitations_evident: Production before-after comparisons lack randomized controls
Novel services lack domain knowledge
Offline evidence uses 104 events from one production setting

title: AgenticRecTune: Multi-Agent with Self-Evolving Skillhub for Recommendation System Optimization
problem: Multi-stage recommender configuration tuning requires expensive specialist iteration under shifting competing production metrics.
assumption_broken: Online configuration search can learn reusable tuning expertise from its own experiments rather than rely on fixed expert search spaces.
operational_signature: Propose → critique → deploy randomized tests → distill outcomes into skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Insight and Skill agents turn online experiment history into Skillhub guidance for subsequent multi-objective configuration proposals.

improver_modified.how: The self-evolving Skillhub updates domain strategies and search guidance used by the Actor and Online agents.

limitations_evident: Live production experiments require costly traffic
Reported metrics are anonymized
No Skillhub-specific ablation isolates self-evolution

title: Web2BigTable: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent LLM System for Internet-Scale Information Search and Extraction
problem: Web-to-table agents struggle with coverage and consistency across many entities and long search trajectories.
assumption_broken: Task decomposition and worker execution can both learn persistent reusable skills with frozen base models.
operational_signature: Decompose → coordinate parallel search → verify against references → reflect into skill banks
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate orchestrator and worker skill banks improve through reference-grounded reflection while a shared workboard exposes coverage gaps.
limitations_evident: Training queries perturb benchmark task parameters
Each benchmark receives its own strategy training
Published baseline results use differing models and infrastructure

title: Self-Evolving Software Agents
problem: Adaptive agents remain limited to goals and capabilities fixed at design time.
assumption_broken: Agents can autonomously discover requirements and evolve goals, reasoning, and executable behavior.
operational_signature: Monitor experience → identify unmet needs → synthesize changes → select and inherit behavior
load_bearing_mechanism: An LLM-driven evolution module operates alongside BDI reasoning to generate new requirements and corresponding code updates.
limitations_evident: Preliminary prototype evaluation
Weak behavioral inheritance and stability
Scalability remains unresolved

title: Skills-Coach: A Self-Evolving Skill Optimizer via Training-Free GRPO
problem: Individually authored skills have fragmented capability coverage and brittle behavior on advanced tasks.
assumption_broken: Skill instructions and executable code can be jointly improved using a small automatically generated task suite without parameter training.
operational_signature: Generate boundary tasks → propose variants → execute and compare → select and repair
load_bearing_mechanism: Group-relative evaluation selects skill instruction variants while execution-grounded auto-fixing repairs associated code.
limitations_evident: Synthetic task and rubric quality determine evaluation validity
Only eight test tasks per skill
Near-perfect skills show little optimization benefit

title: From Context to Skills: Can Language Models Learn from Context Skillfully?
problem: Dense unseen contexts are costly to convert into reliable procedural skills without annotations or external task feedback.
assumption_broken: Adversarial self-play can supply skill-learning feedback from context alone while evolving both solver and challenger skills.
operational_signature: Generate probes → solve and judge → diagnose and rewrite both sides → replay and select
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-time replay selects skill snapshots balancing representative easy and hard cases to prevent adversarial collapse.

improver_modified.how: Challenger skill updates improve the task-and-rubric generation strategy that drives subsequent Reasoner skill evolution.

limitations_evident: Later self-play can produce pathological tasks and overspecialized skills
Judge shares evaluation-model family
API budget limits exploration of longer self-play

title: Lifting Traces to Logic: Programmatic Skill Induction with Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
problem: State-blind skill scripts cannot reliably branch or bind variables in changing long-horizon environments.
assumption_broken: Skills should encode state-dependent execution logic rather than parameterized action sequences.
operational_signature: Segment traces → synthesize symbolic control → check consistency → graft recovery logic
load_bearing_mechanism: Neural observation grounding feeds explicit symbolic control graphs that are locally repaired using successful recovery trajectories.
limitations_evident: Induction assumes segmented demonstrations
Trace consistency does not ensure online correctness
Symbolic execution depends on neural state tracking

title: SkillOS: Learning Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Heuristic skill curation cannot learn long-term repository management from delayed downstream utility.
assumption_broken: A small trained skill curator can outperform a stronger zero-shot curator while leaving the executor frozen.
operational_signature: Group related tasks → execute and curate → measure future utility → train curator
load_bearing_mechanism: Grouped task streams assign downstream executor rewards to curation operations, supplemented by validity, quality, and compactness rewards.

improver_modified.how: GRPO trains the skill-curation policy that adds, updates, and deletes repository skills.

limitations_evident: Training requires 16 H100 GPUs for multiple days
Task grouping depends on teacher-generated attributes
Outcome supervision uses self-judged correctness

title: SHARP: A Self-Evolving Human-Auditable Rubric Policy for Financial Trading Agents
problem: Noisy delayed trading rewards cause free-form prompt optimization to drift through poor credit assignment.
assumption_broken: Trading adaptation can operate through localized auditable rule edits rather than unrestricted prompt rewriting.
operational_signature: Backtest → attribute recurring losses → mutate atomic rules → validate walk-forward
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-sample rule-level attribution guides atomic rubric edits gated by held-out validation with an exploration tolerance.
limitations_evident: Only three walk-forward windows support directional evidence
Rule activation traces are self-reported
Backtest omits market impact and realistic slippage

title: Rethinking Experience Utilization in Self-Evolving Language Model Agents
problem: Rigid experience injection wastes context and ignores when individual decisions need guidance.
assumption_broken: Experience utilization need not be fixed independently of the agent's current reasoning state.
operational_signature: Reason → request guidance → retrieve experience → act selectively
load_bearing_mechanism: An explicit reasoning-time retrieval trigger makes unchanged experience stores optional resources rather than mandatory context.

improver_modified.how: Optional GRPO training updates the policy that decides when to retrieve experience.

limitations_evident: Reinforcement learning evaluated only on two smaller backbones
Retrieval quality depends on unchanged framework repositories
Training compute cost lacks a full accounting

title: LLMs Improving LLMs: Agentic Discovery for Test-Time Scaling
problem: Hand-designed inference allocation heuristics leave useful accuracy-cost strategies unexplored.
assumption_broken: Researchers can design a replayable discovery environment instead of manually specifying each inference controller.
operational_signature: Replay → inspect traces → edit controller → select tradeoff
load_bearing_mechanism: Fixed offline trajectory replay makes controller evaluation cheap enough for trace-guided code search with a single monotone tradeoff parameter.
limitations_evident: All evaluations use pre-collected replay trajectories
Only five discovery rounds are evaluated
Discovery cost may exclude trajectory collection

title: MemQ: Integrating Q-Learning into Self-Evolving Memory Agents over Provenance DAGs
problem: Local memory-value updates fail to credit ancestor experiences that indirectly enable future successes.
assumption_broken: Memory utility depends on downstream construction dependencies rather than only immediate retrieval outcomes.
operational_signature: Retrieve → record provenance → observe outcome → propagate credit
load_bearing_mechanism: TD-inspired eligibility updates propagate outcome credit backward through memory-provenance paths with depth-dependent decay.

improver_modified.how: Learned per-memory Q-values update the policy selecting experiences for subsequent memory construction.

limitations_evident: Provenance records exposure rather than causal influence
Per-memory value approximation omits retrieval-set interactions
Convergence analysis assumes a fixed provenance graph

title: CoCoDA: Co-evolving Compositional DAG for Tool-Augmented Agents
problem: Growing executable skill libraries overload retrieval context while planners fail to exploit newly learned compositions.
assumption_broken: Executable skills should be organized by typed invocation structure rather than treated as flat text memories.
operational_signature: Execute → abstract successful traces → validate compositions → update routing
load_bearing_mechanism: A compositional code DAG jointly supports staged typed retrieval and saved-primitive-call rewards for planner training.
limitations_evident: Specification-filter guarantees assume faithful LLM judgments
Training and evaluation splits are unspecified in supplied text
Multimodal and multi-agent extensions remain future work

title: MLS-Bench: A Holistic and Rigorous Assessment of AI Systems on Building Better AI
problem: Single-instance engineering benchmarks confound reusable method invention with tuning and evaluator exploitation.
assumption_broken: An improved visible benchmark score does not establish a generalizable scalable method.
operational_signature: Constrain edits → propose method → test across settings → submit artifact
load_bearing_mechanism: Baseline-calibrated edit scopes and protected protocols isolate method changes while multi-setting evaluation probes transfer.
limitations_evident: Main protocol exposes multiple evaluation settings during iteration
Reduced scales cannot establish behavior at larger regimes
Expensive verification limits exploration

title: RewardHarness: Self-Evolving Agentic Post-Training
problem: Image-editing reward models require extensive preference annotations and conceal evaluation knowledge in weights.
assumption_broken: Preference alignment can be learned through editable evaluation context rather than reward-model weight training.
operational_signature: Judge → compare preferences → revise evaluation artifacts → gate updates
load_bearing_mechanism: Reasoning-chain error analysis evolves a compact skill-and-tool library whose edits survive only strict validation improvement.
limitations_evident: Evolution repeatedly selects on a small validation set
Orchestrator cost and capability tradeoffs remain uncharacterized
Evidence is concentrated in instruction-guided image editing

title: Ace-Skill: Bootstrapping Multimodal Agents with Prioritized and Clustered Evolution
problem: Uninformative rollouts and heterogeneous knowledge interference reinforce poor multimodal-agent adaptation.
assumption_broken: Rollout allocation and experience organization should be optimized together rather than independently fixed.
operational_signature: Prioritize samples → execute → distill clustered knowledge → update proficiency
load_bearing_mechanism: Lazy-decayed Bayesian proficiency sampling is coupled to cluster-isolated tactical experiences and strategic skills.

improver_modified.how: Observed rewards update proficiency estimates that allocate future knowledge-building rollouts.

limitations_evident: Semantic clusters are fixed rather than adapted online
Sub-9B models require a stronger verifier
Only four tool categories are studied
